c.tagline: Andalusian city of the Mezquita, patio courtyards, and three cultures woven in stone.

taxi.fareNote: Uber does not operate in Córdoba; Cabify and licensed metered white taxis are the options.

emergency.note: 112 is the general EU emergency number connecting to police, fire, and ambulance.

avoid.reason: Pickpocketing in the centre and around the bus terminal; caution at night

hood_desc: Córdoba's iconic UNESCO old quarter of whitewashed lanes and flower-filled courtyards wrapped around the Mezquita-Catedral; the most atmospheric — and most photographed — place to stay, with landmarks at every turn.
The lively commercial heart around Plaza de las Tendillas, full of shops, tapas bars and tabernas; a convenient, well-connected base a short walk from the monuments.
The Alcázar Viejo neighborhood famous for its award-winning private patios and the May Patios Festival; a quieter, quintessentially Cordoban corner beside the Alcázar and the old city walls.
The historic eastern old town around the arcaded Plaza de la Corredera, with lively local markets, taverns and a less touristy, more authentic buzz after dark.
The modern district around the AVE high-speed station and the Vial Norte, with contemporary hotels and easy transport; practical and affordable, a 15-minute walk or quick bus from the old town.
lodging: Las Casas de la Judería de Córdoba

water.note: Tap water is safe to drink throughout the city.

transit.hours: City buses generally run from about 6:30 AM to 11:00 PM, with a limited late-night line on weekends; there is no metro or tram.
transit.note: Córdoba's compact historic core is best explored on foot; public transport is the AUCORSA city bus network, supplemented by taxis. There is no metro or tram.
transit.pay: Pay the driver in cash (single ~€1.30) or tap the rechargeable Tarjeta de Transporte / bank card; day and multi-trip cards offer discounts.

air: Nearest: Seville Airport (SVQ, ~130 km) or Málaga Airport (AGP, ~165 km)
bus: Córdoba bus station (intercity ALSA coaches, next to the train station)
train: Córdoba railway station (AVE high-speed to Madrid, Seville & Málaga; Renfe long-distance and Media Distancia)

airport.name: Seville Airport (SVQ) — nearest with scheduled flights (~130 km); Córdoba's own airport has no regular commercial service

transit.m: Airport bus EA to Sevilla-Santa Justa, then Renfe/AVE train to Córdoba (~1.5 hr total)
Direct taxi/transfer from Seville Airport to Córdoba (~1 hr 20 min)

tip.r: Service is included; locals typically round up or leave small change, or 5-10% for good restaurant service.
